Texture Coordinate Generation for Volume — Half-texel offset coordinate generation
definition: Generates texture coordinates for the 8 corners of the volume box to map the 3D texture correctly, accounting for half-texel offsets.
summary: Texture Coordinate Generation for Volume computes normalized coordinates for a 3D volume box's corners, applying half-texel offsets to ensure correct 3D texture mapping.
